creative_liberties: Timeline compression: Hamza's infiltration (2001+) overlaps with events actually spanning decades
Character consolidation: Multiple real Lyari operatives consolidated into single figures (Shakeel Commando)
Demonetisation: Portrayed as targeted intelligence operation; actual policy had broader economic scope
26/11 Prevention: Hamza potentially could have gathered actionable intel; actual Indian intelligence was fragmented
Khanani Javed Death: Immediate post-demonetisation link implied causality; actual circumstances disputed
film_2_span: 2013-2022 (Pappu beheading through Mistry killing, Punjab arc, demonetisation)
film_3_span: 2016-2019 (Burhan Wani through Article 370; Surgical Strikes, Balakot, Abhinandan)
film_4_span: 2020-2025 (Galwan through Red Fort; Pahalgam, Sindoor, white-collar terror epilogue)
oracle_expansion: Parts 3-4 encyclopedia created for agent reference; real-world events 2016-2025 documented for potential franchise continuation
